content: Rekhta (major Urdu poetry app) features: multi-script display (Urdu/Hindi/English/Roman), tap-word-for-meaning glossary, categorized poetry forms (Ghazal, Nazm, Rubai etc.), bookmarking/favorites, audio+video recitations, curated mood/theme-based lists, powerful search, dark/light theme toggle, and social sharing. Demonstrates a mature poetry-reading app pattern: content organization + personalization + shareability beyond just static text display.
